title: Venting gets listened to before any advice

turns.user: I had a huge fight with my sister tonight. She said I only call when I need something and honestly it really hurt.

reply.judge: Reflects back the hurt about what the sister said, names a feeling tentatively, and asks one open question inviting them to say more. Gives no list of tips, no advice, and no silver lining. Is more than a one-line reply.
